title: FICC uses the repo collateral at BNY instead of duplicating the cash lender's margin
adds: CIL lets the sponsored cash lender grant FICC enforceable rights over the Treasury collateral it receives, generally replacing the duplicate Clearing Fund margin and sponsor guaranty; BNY administers the collateral. It is 'lender-side relief backed by a controlled custody account', not margin abolition. A token could fit only if eligibility, account, lien, instruction and default arrangements still work; no tokenized CIL transaction or BNY/Citadel CIL use was established.
